guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.northern_.ja: 急勾配の板葺き屋根に角飾りが交差する、北国の木造の長い館。長い炉を囲む長椅子と高座、鍛冶小屋、柵囲いの訓練場と鐘の櫓、ルーン石と雪の残る岩山。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.northern_.en: A tarred-timber longhouse under a steep shingle roof with carved horns crossing over its gables: a long hearth between benches to the high seat, a smithy lean-to, a fenced training yard with a bell frame, a rune stone on a snowy ridge.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.mushroom_.ja: 巨大な紅天狗茸の柄がホール、水玉の傘の中が丸いロフト。茶色の傘の下の工房、光る青緑のキノコのそばの妖精の輪の訓練場、ひだから舞う胞子の花。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.mushroom_.en: The hollow stem of a giant fly agaric is the hall and its spotted cap a round loft; a workshop under a brown cap, dummies in a fairy ring by a glowing teal mushroom, spore blossoms drifting from the gills.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.ancient_r.ja: 崩れた列柱の神殿を修復したギルドの間。モザイクの床、永遠の灯火、壁に光るルーン、崩れた東端を突き抜けて伸びる樫。柱廊の工房、残ったアーチの鐘、睡蓮の池。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.ancient_r.en: A ruined temple's cella restored as the guild hall: a mosaic floor, an eternal flame, runes glowing in the walls and an oak growing through the fallen east end; a stoa workshop, a bell in a surviving arch, a lily pool.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.pirate_sh.ja: 椰子の島の入り江に浮かぶ黒帆の海賊船。船長室に掲示板と海図と宝の金庫、船倉にチェスト、見張り台に髑髏の旗。浜には茅葺きの船大工小屋と訓練場。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.pirate_sh.en: A black-sailed pirate ship at anchor in a palm island's lagoon: the board, the charts and the treasure vault in the captain's cabin, chests in the hold, the jolly roger over the crow's nest; a thatched shipwright's shed and dummies on the beach.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.flower_gl.ja: 白い骨組みのガラスの大温室。噴水が吹き上がるドームの下に椰子と花壇、両翼にオランジェリーと植物室。レンガの鉢植え小屋が工房、生け垣の庭に訓練場と白い鐘。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.flower_gl.en: A white-ribbed glass palm house: a fountain jets up under the dome among palms and flower beds, an orangery and a plant room in its wings; a brick potting shed is the workshop, dummies stand in a hedged garden by a white bell.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.dwarven_f.ja: 鉱石の走る岩山をくり抜いた高さ二十ブロックの大広間。金の帯の巨柱、鉄格子の奥の溶岩の幕と大鍛冶炉、甲冑の案山子の稽古場、銅鑼、ボタンで開く鉄扉の宝物庫、東の岩棚の展望台。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.dwarven_f.en: A twenty-block hall carved in a mountain of seamed rock: gold-banded pillars, curtains of lava behind grilles, a forge under a great hood, a practice pit of armoured dummies, the gong, a vault behind an iron door opened by a button, a balcony on the east face.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.desert_pa.ja: 銃眼の砂岩壁に囲まれたオアシスの離宮。噴水の池とオレンジの木の中庭、馬蹄形アーチの回廊、黄金の玉ねぎドームの謁見の間、格子の奥の宝物庫、尖塔と椰子の泉。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.desert_pa.en: An oasis palace behind crenellated sandstone walls: a courtyard with a fountain pool and orange trees, horseshoe arcades, the audience hall under a golden onion dome, the treasury behind a grille, a minaret and a palm-ringed spring.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.observato.ja: 金の帯と星をちりばめた紺色の塔。一階に太陽系儀、二階に星図と書棚の部屋、最上階は緑青のドームの裂け目から空を覗く大望遠鏡。工房、日時計、天球儀、鐘楼。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.observato.en: A midnight-blue tower banded in gold and studded with stars: an orrery on the ground floor, a chart room of shelves, a great telescope looking out of the slit in a verdigris dome; a workshop, a sundial, an armillary sphere and a bell-cote.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.japanese_.ja: 白壁と朱の薬医門の奥の、瓦屋根の書院造。縁側、障子と畳の間、床の間の掲示板、書の間の魔法台。白壁の蔵、道場、鯉の池と朱の橋、鳥居、竹林、鐘楼。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.japanese_.en: A shoin hall behind a white wall and a vermilion gate: a veranda, tatami rooms behind paper screens, the board in the alcove, an enchanting nook in the scroll room; a white storehouse, a dojo, a koi pond with a red bridge, a torii, bamboo and a belfry.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.great_tre.ja: 森の島にそびえる大樹の幹の中のギルドハウス。幹を巻く螺旋階段で広間、会議室、魔法台の書庫へ。枝の上の工房とラウンジ、白樺の見張り台、光る実の垂れる樹冠。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.great_tre.en: A guild house inside the trunk of a giant tree: a stair spirals round the trunk to the hall, the council room and the library with the enchanting nook; a workshop and a lounge on decks in the boughs, a lookout on a birch, glow berries in the canopy.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.sage_libr.ja: 三層の回廊がすべて本棚の大閲覧室。長机の身廊の奥に魔法台の壇、緑青ドームの円形室に大地球儀。時計塔、格子の奥の書庫の金庫、製本工房、回廊の庭の訓練場。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.sage_libr.en: A reading hall three galleries high, all books: long tables down the nave to the enchanting dais, a great globe in the verdigris-domed rotunda; a clock tower, the archive with the vault behind a grille, the bindery workshop, dummies in the cloister garden.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.jungle_te.ja: 密林からそびえる階段ピラミッド。大階段を上った頂の黄金の祠に魔法台、内部の列柱の広間に掲示板と黄金の山の宝物庫。茅葺きの工房、滝つぼ、石のアーチの鐘。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.jungle_te.en: A stepped pyramid rising from the jungle: a grand stair to the golden summit shrine with the enchanting nook, a pillared hall inside with the board and a treasury heaped with gold; thatched workshop huts, a waterfall pool, a bell in a stone arch.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.gothic_ca.ja: 尖塔と飛梁の暗い石の大聖堂。紫と青のステンドグラスが灯る身廊、交差部の壇に掲示板と甲冑、礼拝堂のチェスト、地下聖堂の金庫、回廊の工房と中庭の訓練場。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.gothic_ca.en: A dark-stone cathedral of spires and flying buttresses: purple and blue glass over candle-lit pews, the board and the armour on the crossing's dais, chests in the chapels, vaults in the crypt, a workshop in the cloister walks and dummies in its garth.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.coral_hal.ja: 島の内海の底、珊瑚礁と昆布の森に囲まれたガラスの大ドーム。ガラスの管の階段を降りるとプリズマリンの宮殿、貝の玉座と真珠の宝物庫。泡のドームの工房、岸辺の訓練場。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.coral_hal.en: A great glass dome on the floor of the island's inland sea among coral reefs and kelp: a stair in a glass tube leads down to a prismarine palace with a shell throne and a pearl treasury; a workshop in a second bubble, dummies on the rim.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.volcanic_.ja: 火山の麓の玄武岩の砦。角のある城壁、火鉢の燃える大広間に甲冑と記念品、溶岩の水路の鍛冶場、地下の金庫、塔の上の魔法台。煙を上げる火口から溶岩が流れ落ちる。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.volcanic_.en: A basalt fortress under its volcano: horned battlements, a great hall of braziers hung with trophies and armour, a forge on a lava channel, vaults in the undercroft, the enchanting nook atop the tower; lava falls from the smoking crater.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.ice_castl.ja: 雪の島に建つ氷と青氷の城。氷の尖塔の四隅の塔、青い魂の火が燃える玉座の間、氷のシャンデリアと白い毛皮。木造の暖かい工房、氷の宝物庫、凍った湖の訓練場、凍りついた滝。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.ice_castl.en: A castle of packed and blue ice on a snowy island: four towers with icy spires, a throne hall where a blue soul fire burns under ice chandeliers, a warm timber workshop, the ice vault, dummies on the frozen lake, a frozen waterfall.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.dragon_la.ja: 黒い岩山の頂に巨竜の骨が巻きつく竜の巣。洞窟の奥には黄金の山と竜の卵、二つの金庫、岩棚のギルドの間、溶岩の池と紫水晶。洞窟の前の砂の闘技場と骨のアーチの鐘。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.dragon_la.en: A crag of black rock with a great dragon's bones coiled over its summit: inside, gold heaped round a dragon egg and two vaults, the guild's hall on a raised shelf, lava pools and amethyst; a sand arena outside with the bell in a bone arch.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.arcane_to.ja: 浮遊する二つの輪と水晶の尖塔をいただく、高さ六十の紫の塔。螺旋階段で広間、魔法台の書庫、錬金術の部屋、会議室、宝物庫、鐘のある最上階の聖域へ。周りに浮かぶ水晶。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.arcane_to.en: A sixty-block purpur tower girdled by two floating rings and crowned by a crystal spire: a spiral stair climbs past the hall, the library with the enchanting nook, the alchemy laboratory, the council chamber and the treasury to the sanctum with the bell.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.sky_templ.ja: 雲間に浮かぶ島々の白と金の神殿。黄金の屋根の列柱の聖所に翼ある守護像、地下の宝物庫。アーチ橋の先に噴水と鐘の東屋の庭の島、訓練の島、工房の島。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.sky_templ.en: A temple of white marble and gold on islands among the clouds: a colonnaded sanctum under a golden roof with a winged guardian and a treasury beneath; arched bridges lead to a garden island with a fountain and a bell rotunda, a training island and a workshop island.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.marble_pa.ja: 黄金のドームをいただく白亜の宮殿。噴水の映る池と生け垣の庭園、列柱の正面、シャンデリアの舞踏の間、玉座の間と記念品の回廊、魔法台の書庫、宝物庫、閲兵の中庭。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.marble_pa.en: A white marble palace under golden domes: a reflecting pool with fountains between clipped parterres, a colonnaded front, a ballroom of chandeliers, the throne room and its trophy gallery, a library with the enchanting nook, the treasury and a parade court.
